resources.name: Extended three-body force shell model

access.notes: Described in papers: Goyal & Asthana, Infrared Phys. 31, 195 (1991); Asthana & Goyal, Infrared Phys. 31, 413 (1991); Asthana et al., Infrared Phys. 33, 317 (1992). The agent must implement the model from these references.

resources.notes: The extended three-body force shell model is a classical ionic model for alkali halides. The equations are obtainable from the cited publications.

resources.name: NumPy
resources.notes: Python package for numerical computation. Not strictly required but helpful for implementing the model.
